Ketogenic 7-Day Meal Prep Plan Overview
This plan delivers approximately 2000 calories and under 30g net carbs daily for one adult, emphasizing high-fat meats, eggs, cheese, and low-carb veggies while excluding seafood and peanuts. Meals are simple to prep in bulk on Sunday afternoon, focusing on chicken, turkey, beef, and pork for variety and satiety.

Dietary Foundations and Portion Notes
Plan assumes moderate activity level for a 2000-calorie target, with macros averaging 150-200g fat, 150g protein, 25g net carbs daily based on standard keto ratios from sample plans. All recipes use common ingredients to fit $120 budget; portions scaled for one person (e.g., 6-8oz protein per main meal). Net carbs calculated as total carbs minus fiber. Hydrate with water or black coffee/tea; add salt for electrolytes.

7-Day Meal Schedule and Macros Table

| Day | Breakfast (cal/net carbs) | Lunch (cal/net carbs) | Dinner (cal/net carbs) | Snacks (cal/net carbs) | Daily Total |
|-----|---------------------------|-----------------------|------------------------|------------------------|-------------|
| 1 | 3 eggs scrambled w/ 2oz cheese (450/2g) | Chicken salad: 6oz chicken, 1/2 avocado, greens (550/5g) | Ground turkey patties (8oz) w/ broccoli (550/6g) | Cheese stick + pecans (1oz) (450/4g) | 2000/17g |
| 2 | Omelet w/ spinach, 2oz cheese (450/3g) | Turkey slices (6oz) w/ cucumber, cream cheese (550/4g) | Baked chicken thighs (8oz) w/ zucchini (550/5g) | Cottage cheese (1/2 cup) + sunflower seeds (1oz) (450/5g) | 2000/17g |
| 3 | Boiled eggs (3) + 1oz walnuts (450/3g) | Beef stir-fry (6oz ground beef, bell peppers) (550/6g) | Pork chops (8oz) w/ cauliflower mash (550/5g) | String cheese (2) + celery w/ cream cheese (450/4g) | 2000/18g |
| 4 | Cheese (3oz) + avocado (1/2) (450/4g) | Chicken breast (6oz) salad w/ mixed greens (550/5g) | Turkey burger (8oz) no bun, side salad (550/5g) | Pecans (1oz) + hard-boiled egg (450/3g) | 2000/17g |
| 5 | Egg muffins w/ bacon (3 slices), cheese (450/2g) | Ground beef bowl w/ broccoli (550/6g) | Baked pork (8oz) w/ asparagus (550/5g) | Sunflower seeds (1oz) + cottage cheese (450/5g) | 2000/18g |
| 6 | Scrambled eggs (3) w/ cream cheese (450/2g) | Chicken thighs (6oz) w/ zucchini noodles (550/5g) | Beef patties (8oz) w/ spinach (550/6g) | Walnuts (1oz) + cheese stick (450/4g) | 2000/17g |
| 7 | Omelet w/ mushrooms, 2oz cheese (450/3g) | Turkey salad w/ avocado (550/5g) | Chicken wings (8oz) baked w/ cauliflower (550/5g) | Cottage cheese + pecans (450/4g) | 2000/17g |

Sunday Afternoon Prep Timeline
1-2pm: Cook proteins in batches - bake 3lbs chicken (breasts/thighs/wings), 2lbs ground turkey/beef patties, 2lbs pork chops (season w/ salt/pepper/garlic powder; 375F oven 25-35min). Boil 12 eggs.
2-3pm: Chop veggies - 2 bunches broccoli/cauliflower, 4 zucchini, 2 bell peppers, 1 cucumber, asparagus, spinach/greens (store in containers). Mash cauliflower w/ butter.
3-4pm: Prep salads/snacks - slice avocados (3), portion cheeses/nuts/seeds into bags, mix cream cheese dips. Assemble 7 lunch/dinner containers.
4-5pm: Cool, portion snacks, refrigerate (use within 5 days; freeze extras). Total prep time: 4 hours.

Budget Grocery List (Total ~$115 USD)
Proteins (45$): 3lbs chicken breast/thighs/wings ($25), 2lbs ground turkey ($8), 1lb ground beef ($6), 1lb pork chops ($6).
Dairy/Eggs (30$): 2 dozen eggs ($6), 1lb cheddar/string cheese ($8), 16oz cream cheese ($4), 24oz cottage cheese ($6), 8oz butter ($6).
Veggies (15$): 2 heads broccoli ($3), 1 cauliflower ($3), 4 zucchini ($3), mixed greens/spinach (2 bags $3), bell peppers/cucumber/asparagus/celery ($3).
Fats/Nuts (20$): 3 avocados ($4), 4oz walnuts/pecans ($6), 4oz sunflower seeds ($4), olive oil ($6).
Other (5$): Salt/pepper/garlic powder ($3), hot sauce ($2). Shop sales at Walmart/Aldi for savings.

Prep Time: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
